name: code-skills-package
description: Unified AI programming skills for 18 coding platforms — auto-routing, lazy loading, spec-driven workflows

scripts.postinstall: echo '' && echo '  CSP installed! Run in your project directory:' && echo '    cd /your/project && csp-install' && echo ''
scripts.build:all: npm run build:registry && npm run build:metadata && npm run gen:triggers && npm run fix:triggers && npm run build:graph && npm run build:page
scripts.validate:skills: node scripts/validate-skill-v2.mjs csp-patterns/skills && node scripts/validate-skill-v2.mjs csp-meta/skills && node scripts/validate-skill-v2.mjs csp-workflow/skills && node scripts/validate-skill-v2.mjs csp-runtime/skills && node scripts/count-skills.mjs
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate:skills && npm run validate:triggers && npm run validate:registry
scripts.test: npm run validate:all && npm run build:graph && node --test 'test/*.test.mjs'
